## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Salzburg, Austria. It starts at Residenzplatz 1.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Take an Austrian adventure tour through the magnificent Baroque power center of the former prince-archbishops. Discover the cultural highlight in the heart of Salzburg with these tickets to the DomQuartier, and find out how, over 400 years ago, the Salzburg aristocracy transformed the town into an Italian-style Baroque treasure. It's a masterpiece of urban design to this day!
>
> Plug into your audio guide and let history guide the way through the state rooms, the Residence Gallery, the Cathedral Museum and St. Peter's Museum. Other highlights include magnificent views of Salzburg's old town from the cathedral arch terrace, and of Salzburg Cathedral from the organ loft.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €13.50. It was rated 4.6 out of 5 from 28 ratings and 13 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
